newsitem.title: GREECE: BANK OF CYPRUS OPENS 8TH BRANCH IN GREECE.
newsitem.headline: BANK OF CYPRUS OPENS 8TH BRANCH IN GREECE.

text.p: The Bank of Cyprus continuing to expand its presence in Greece launched its eighth branch in Athens at Leoforos Alexandras 170, it announced on Thursday.
"The owned facility is a jewel not only for the branch network of Bank of Cyprus but also for the banking market with particular emphasis in construction quality and high aesthetics," it said.

The new branch will offer the full spectrum of banking services supported by Bank of Cyprus expertise and know-how. Its site will cater to the needs of business and other clients who wish to transact in downtown Athens without being affected by traffic bans in the city's centre, it said.
The bank's headquarters in Greece will transfer to the new building by year end, the Bank of Cyprus said. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
